help.title: 📖 {botName} Help
help.description: Set up your server, pick what to enable, then browse commands below.

getting_started.title: 🚀 Getting Started
getting_started.step1: **1. Launch setup** — Run `/configwizard` to configure prefix, mod role, and logs.
getting_started.step2: **2. Enable systems** — Use `/commands dashboard` to turn categories on or off.
getting_started.step3: **3. Browse commands** — Use the menu below to view categories and commands.

how_it_works.title: ℹ️ How It Works
how_it_works.point1: • Dashboard commands manage each feature visually
how_it_works.point3: • Slash commands and prefixes both work once enabled

help.all_commands_desc: Browse every available command in a single list

menu_closed.title: Help menu closed
menu_closed.description: Help menu has been closed, use /help again.

help.click_to_use: Click any command mention below to use it.
help.no_commands: No commands found in the **{category}** category.

support.title: Need Help?
support.description: Join our official support server for assistance, report bugs, or suggest features. If you are customizing this bot, remember to change the link in the code!

commands.permission_error: You need the **Manage Server** permission to manage commands.
commands.category_not_found: No category matched `{target}`. Use `/commands dashboard` to browse categories.
commands.category_disabled_desc:
All **{category}** commands are now disabled.
Protected commands remain available.
commands.category_enabled_desc: **{category}** commands are now enabled (except individually disabled commands).
commands.command_disabled_desc: `/{command}` is now disabled in this server.
commands.command_enabled_desc: `/{command}` is now enabled in this server.

commands_dashboard.title: ⚙️ Command Access
commands_dashboard.description: Manage slash and prefix commands for **{server}**. Subcommands (e.g. `birthday list`) are listed separately.
commands_dashboard.legend_text: {on} All enabled · {partial} Some disabled · {off} Category off
commands_dashboard.how_to_use_overview:
• Select a category below to manage commands and subcommands
• `/commands disable` — turn off a category or specific command
• `/commands enable` — turn something back on
commands_dashboard.how_to_use_category:
• Use the dropdown to toggle individual commands or subcommands
• **Disable All** turns off the whole category
• **Clear Overrides** re-enables individually disabled entries
